root_cause_label: Manual /etc/shadow edit with wrong hash scheme destroys valid credentials; agent never diagnoses actual auth failure root cause and enters destructive loop
one_sentence_failure_summary: After repeatedly failing SSH password authentication despite correctly setting credentials, the agent adopted the false premise that the password hash scheme was wrong, manually replaced the valid yescrypt hash with SHA-512 in /etc/shadow (step 54), then escalated to clearing the password field entirely (step 65), irreversibly breaking authentication while never discovering the actual cause of initial failures, and ending the trajectory stuck on a git safe.directory error with the deployment pipeline completely unvalidated.
t_err_evidence: sshpass ... git@127.0.0.1 ... exit code 5; Permission denied, please try again. (password auth setup is broken)
t_commit_evidence: Step 65: agent runs `sed -i 's/^git:.*/git::0:99999:7:::/' /etc/shadow`, replacing the entire git shadow entry with an empty password field. This destroys any remaining possibility of password authentication. Even though the agent partially restores the $6$ hash at step 68, the $6$ scheme remains wrong. From step 65 onward the agent's actual subsequent behavior (continuing shadow edits with wrong hash, then pivoting to local file-protocol pushes blocked by safe.directory errors) makes failure certain.
t_surface_evidence: Permission denied, please try again. [The command completed with exit code 5.]
trigger_explanation: At step 53, the agent generates a SHA-512 hash via `openssl passwd -6 password` to 'compare' or 'fix' the hash, apparently assuming the hash scheme ($y$ yescrypt vs $6$ SHA-512) is what's causing auth failures. This unverified assumption leads directly to the step 54 shadow edit that replaces the valid yescrypt hash with SHA-512, which PAM on Ubuntu will reject. The agent never ran any diagnostic to confirm what was actually causing the auth failures (could have been an sshd_config.d file, PAM configuration, or other factor) before taking this destructive action.
forewarning_evidence: Permission denied, please try again. (repeated sshpass auth test, exit code 5)
